t.E392.agn: In 2018 EFSA recalculated exposure and, based on JECFA's temporary daily intake limit (0.3 mg/kg body weight, as carnosic acid + carnosol), calculated margins of safety of 100–2,000 in children and 200–3,000 in adults; it stated that the estimates most probably overestimate actual exposure.
t.E392.prod: Obtained from rosemary leaves by extraction.
t.E392.regx.0: Exposure recalculated; a wide margin of safety was found relative to JECFA's temporary ADI (0.3 mg/kg, carnosic acid + carnosol).
t.E392.summary: A natural antioxidant obtained from rosemary leaves. It delays rancidity in fats, meat products and sauces.
t.E392.what: An antioxidant of natural origin obtained from rosemary that delays fats turning rancid. Its active components are carnosic acid and carnosol.
